final: WITH g AS (SELECT feecoin, AVG(rebtotal) AS ar, AVG(CASE WHEN feerate = 0 THEN NULL ELSE (rebrate - feerate) / feerate END) AS ag FROM fees GROUP BY feecoin), b AS (SELECT AVG(ar) AS bm FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.ar) AS avg_rebtotal, AVG(g.ag) AS avg_rel_gap, AVG(g.ar - b.bm) AS avg_excess FROM g, b WHERE g.ar > b.bm
